title: Let a caller prefer a named profile without requiring it
lead:
A repository render script that wants its brand when it is available has
two options today. `--config NAME` fails on any machine where NAME is not
registered. Leaving it out loses the brand on machines where it is
registered but not the user's `default`. Neither lets a shared script name
a profile without making every machine register it.
boundary:
**Not in this slice:** finding or downloading profiles; a repository-local
quire config file; changing `--config`, which stays strict.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Scripts in other repositories pin a profile name so documents render the
same for everyone. A collaborator without that profile should still get a
plain PDF and a warning, not a failed build.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
1. `--prefer-config NAME` with NAME registered selects that profile, as
   `--config NAME` does.
2. With NAME unregistered, quire prints one warning to stderr (naming the
   config file and the `quire install` hint from s14) and continues down the
   normal selection order: `QUIRE_CONFIG`, `QUIRE_PROFILE`, the user
   `default`, then plain output.
3. `--prefer-config` with `--config`, `--profile` or `--no-config` follows
   the existing precedence; `--prefer-config` with `--config` is a usage
   error.
4. An unregistered preferred name with `--letterhead` still fails, and the
   error says the preferred profile was not registered.
5. A registered name whose profile directory is missing still fails, as
   `_check_config_profile` does today. Only an unregistered name falls back.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Owner decision first: flag name (`--prefer-config` proposed) and whether a
`QUIRE_PREFER_CONFIG` environment variable is also wanted. Add the flag in
`_parser` and handle it in `resolve_profile_arg` at the `--config` slot:
registered returns the path, unregistered warns and falls through. Reuse
the s14 message for the warning text. Update the selection order in the
README and the "Behavior to preserve" list in `AGENTS.md`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `python3 test_quire.py`
- Real build with `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` pointed at an empty temporary directory
  inside the checkout: `--prefer-config acme` writes a plain PDF and warns.
  Report whether the PDF was checked.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: No commit unless the owner asks.
